Settings.themeDescription: Set the color mode for the current interface

Settings.deleteCategoryDescription: Delete the category {name}? Its entries will become uncategorized.

Settings.aiPromptPlaceholder:
e.g.:
• Split service fees into a separate item
• Classify taxi as Transport
• Use concise merchant-first titles
